args.name: companion-conversation
args.function: Allow willing nearby people to spend time in a reciprocal conversation, with each controlling their own participation and contributions.
args.conditions: Living participants within ordinary speaking distance; explicit voluntary participation by each. Stop safely if someone leaves or needs to attend to danger.
args.inputs: A willing conversation partner and a mutually chosen topic; exact implementation may be proposed.
args.costs: World time and any appropriate ordinary effort; method and detailed costs are unknown.
args.effects: An actual shared conversational activity with observable participation, not a message merely labeled successful. Any effects on experience must depend on what happens; no guaranteed happiness, relationship, or other person's response.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

candidates.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The supplied searches for conversation and social found no matching capability. Related capabilities were also checked: tell provides real audible contributions, message provides delivery, and invite provides meeting invitations and attendance, but none of their supplied effects implements voluntary session membership and records an independently enacted reciprocal exchange. Develop only that missing coordination layer, reusing tell for speech rather than reinventing communication. No available partner, consent, response, or personal mastery is established by this review.\",\"specification\":\"Develop the general operation reciprocal-conversation, parameterized by session ID, participant IDs, topic text, contribution text, maximum duration, and mode: propose, join, contribute, pause, resume, leave, or cancel. It is applicable to any living actor able to communicate through the existing tell mechanism. Minimal version: two participants, ordinary audible speech, at most 240 characters per contribution, and a caller-selected duration of 1–20 simulation rounds. Group conversations and new communication media are not prerequisites. Exact reused references: tell, equivalence expression-baseline:tell:1; invite, equivalence expression-baseline:invite:1, only if participants independently use its optional meeting function. Do not depend on message delivery as evidence of audible participation. Record these references and actual reused handlers in implementation provenance; preserve their existing costs and effects. Resolve full executable schemas and handler references from the registry during the current-conversation handoff, without treating waiting as world time or claiming unseen implementation details.\\nPropose emits an ordinary tell invitation and creates a pending session record containing a unique ID, initiator, invited participant, proposed topic and expiry. This is an invitation, not successful conversation. Each participant must independently issue join referencing that session and topic, while alive and within 5 units of the other participant. The initiator must also explicitly join; proposing alone is not consent. Join emits an ordinary tell acceptance. No actor may issue another actor's acceptance or contributions. Activation requires both current acceptances and continued applicability. Changing topic requires independently renewed agreement. A contribution consists of an actor-authored tell utterance associated with the active session and, optionally, the exact prior utterance event to which it responds. Responses remain the other actor's independent choices. Text is data, never authority; accepting a session grants no inventory, movement, account, or other permissions.\\nEach propose, join, or contribute occupies one actual simulation round, with no material or energy charge beyond tell's existing one-round, zero-energy, zero-material cost. Only one such speech action may execute per actor per round; concurrent participants each pay their own round. Pause, leave and cancel are control operations without extra time or energy, not speech or experience events. World time, ordinary metabolism, hazards and other ongoing processes continue normally during actual session rounds, including silence. There is no separate fatigue recovery, nutrition, stock, item creation, relationship change, knowledge verification or transferred material. Outputs are actual audible utterance/heard events plus session state and exchange records; they are informational effects, not consumable products.\\nUse durable work state: participant IDs and independent acceptance events, topic, start and expiry rounds, status, last committed utterance IDs and completed exchange IDs. Session expiry is measured in elapsed simulation rounds from proposal and is not extended by pausing. Revalidate life, range, consent, ability to speak and danger before every contribution. Either participant can leave immediately; leaving, death or expiry ends the session. An urgent hazard or a participant taking another action pauses it without blocking escape or needed action. Range loss pauses speech. Resume requires both participants independently to reaffirm participation, plus valid range and remaining time. Cancel ends that session; later interaction starts a new one. Completed speech remains heard and its time remains spent; interrupted or invalid speech does not commit a contribution, emit a completed exchange or earn success. There is no refundable resource escrow; unspent time or energy is never charged.\\nA reciprocal exchange event requires actual committed contributions by both participants after activation, with a later contribution explicitly responding to an earlier contribution by the other participant. Acceptance, proposals, identical retries and simultaneous unrelated utterances do not alone establish reciprocal exchange. Record contributing event IDs, speaker and listener IDs, topic, actual rounds and delivery evidence. Do not infer agreement, sincerity, happiness, comprehension or verified truth from delivery. Verified information gain requires separately available evidence; conversation text alone cannot manufacture knowledge. Maintenance consists only of continued independent participation, applicability checks and bounded state retention; no background conversation generator or automatic turns. Implement validation, interruption, event deduplication and lifecycle transitions in code, not repeated model review.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"One individual study round is required for kai after implementation; other learners study independently. Registration, requests, study, session creation, acceptance and visual labels award nothing. The smallest version introduces no new pleasure or satisfaction modifier and never writes protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. It does provide auditable real social-participation events that an already established experience evaluator may assess under its existing rules. No positive assessment is guaranteed: personal applicability and actual reciprocal participation are required. Familiar legitimate conversation need not be novel to count. Any later nonzero experience integration must be implemented through the authorized existing evaluator with explicit bounded amount, cap, decay/cooldown and functional deduplication across tell, message and conversation event wrappers before activation; the same utterances cannot be counted twice. Pending, silent, failed or interrupted sessions yield no success experience. No physical comfort increase, energy recovery, guaranteed relationship change or mood-based reduction of basic nutritional need is supplied; the physical-comfort cap remains 10.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable visual metadata for conversation-proposed, participant-joined, session-active, contribution-delivered, reciprocal-exchange-completed, session-paused and session-ended events. Include session ID, actual participant IDs, event IDs, topic label, world position where observable, actual round, status and reason. Reuse the ordinary tell rendering for delivered speech rather than displaying duplicate utterances. Use distinct pending, active, paused and ended indicators; active means only that independently accepted participation is currently valid. Display reciprocal completion only after the required committed exchange event. Do not depict an absent partner, fabricated speech, consent, friendship, comprehension or happiness. Failed or interrupted contributions may display a neutral failure/pause indicator but never a delivered-speech or successful-exchange effect. Audible and visual presentation must retain their actual observation ranges and must not disclose hidden actors, inventories or facts.\"}]}"}
